🚀 Your Learning Path

1
Foundation & Assessment
⏱️ Week 1 (2-3 hours)
  • 📊
    Take the 10x PMM Scorecard
    Baseline your current AI usage across Content, CI, and Demand Gen — see where you stand vs. the 10x frontier.
  • 🧠
    Complete "Where Do You Sit?"
    Discover your PMM archetype and how AI will transform your specific role.
  • 📖
    Complete Unit 1: The Case for Change
    Understand why AI is transforming PMM and the "full-stack buyer" concept — foundation for everything else.
2
Competitive Intelligence (Your #1 Priority)
⏱️ Week 2 (3-4 hours)
  • 📖
    Complete Unit 3: Competitive Intelligence
    Learn the AI-powered CI framework: monitoring, synthesis, and actionable intelligence.
  • 🧪
    CI Brief Lab
    Build a competitive brief using AI — enter your competitor (Workday? Oracle?) and get a ready-to-use sales brief.
  • 👤
    Read: Lauren Cochrane's CI Engine
    See how another SAP PMM (Concur) is building competitive intelligence with Crayon + Clozd.

🎯 Immediate Win: Use CompeteGPT to monitor Workday, Oracle HCM, and Ceridian. Set up a weekly AI-generated competitive digest using Perplexity + the CI Brief Lab.

3
Content at Scale (Partner Enablement)
⏱️ Week 3 (3-4 hours)
  • 📖
    Complete Unit 4: Content at Scale
    The three-layer content model: what to automate, augment, and protect.
  • 🧪
    Content Audit Lab
    Audit your partner bill of materials — find what to AI-generate vs. human-craft.
  • 📖
    Read: "Your Prompt Is a Workflow"
    Will Scott's framework for building prompts that force you through strategic thinking.

🎯 Immediate Win: Take your L1 pitch deck narrative and use Claude to generate: portal copy, video script, event talking points, and social posts. One source → five outputs in 30 minutes.

4
Messaging & Positioning
⏱️ Week 4 (2-3 hours)
  • 📖
    Complete Unit 2: AI Discoverability
    How AI agents evaluate vendors — critical for partner portal content and HCM.com pages.
  • 🧪
    Positioning Test Lab
    Run the "Agent Test" on your partner messaging — see how an AI procurement agent would evaluate it.
  • 🧪
    GEO Visibility Lab
    Audit your HCM.com pages for AI visibility — are you showing up when buyers ask ChatGPT about HCM?
5
Executive Communications & Personal Brand
⏱️ Ongoing
  • 📖
    Complete Unit 6: Executive Communications
    Frameworks for upward communications that frame work in terms of business impact.
  • 📰
    Subscribe to the Daily Digest
    5-6 AI + PMM stories daily — fuel for your LinkedIn presence and executive updates.

🎯 Immediate Win: Use this prompt template for executive updates: "Summarize [my work] in 3 bullets: (1) Business impact with numbers, (2) Strategic implication, (3) Next milestone. Tone: confident, not defensive."
